title: Xanthan gum: specification monograph, in Compendium of food additive specifications, Addendum 7
authors: Joint FAO/WHO Expert Committee on Food Additives
journal: FAO Food and Nutrition Paper 52, Addendum 7, 53rd meeting of JECFA, Rome, 1 to 10 June 1999
funder: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations and World Health Organization.
result: Xanthan gum carries INS No. 415 and CAS number 11138-66-2. Functional uses: thickener, stabiliser, emulsifier, foaming agent. Definition: a high molecular weight polysaccharide gum produced by pure-culture fermentation of a carbohydrate with Xanthomonas campestris, purified by recovery with ethanol or isopropanol, dried and milled; it contains D-glucose and D-mannose as the dominant hexose units along with D-glucuronic acid and pyruvic acid, is prepared as the sodium, potassium or calcium salt, and its solutions are neutral. ADI 'not specified', established at the 30th JECFA in 1986.
